g.text: first checks if the wallet has sufficient funds to cover

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the maximum potential gas cost, rejecting the operation if it doesn't.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Then, it calls the wallet's function, measures the actual gas used,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and finally reimburses the entity that paid the gas (the executor) from the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: It's forbidden from using banned opcodes (like TIMESTAMP) that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: could change its outcome based on when it's executed.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Additionally, it's restricted to only accessing "associated storage,"

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: which means it can only touch its own data or storage slots

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: in other contracts that are specifically linked to the wallet's address.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: If that deposit is insufficient, it will request the remaining balance

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: directly from the wallet during the validateOp call.

g.text: have any ETH to start using the blockchain.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
